summaries.Romania: Romania faces political deadlock as President Nicușor Dan prepares a third premier nomination amid coalition tensions, while the economy shows signs of stagflation with GDP contraction and rising inflation. Key fiscal challenges and budget concerns dominate as the government struggles to maintain EU deficit targets.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation accelerates with breakthroughs in cancer diagnostics and AI-driven preventive care, while the industry grapples with rising costs and regulatory scrutiny over drug pricing and Medicare compliance. Consolidation continues as health systems pursue strategic M&A to improve operational efficiency.
summaries.Tech: Apple's 'Surprise and Shine' event this Wednesday will debut iPhone 18 Pro with new colors and the C2 modem, while the broader industry faces memory cost inflation driving consumer price hikes; separately, AI regulation concerns mount as major publishers sue OpenAI for unauthorized training data use.

items.title: The real reason your phone is getting more expensive
items.snippet: When Apple debuts the next generation of iPhones this week, they're likely to come with an unwanted change: a higher price tag. A price hike from the supply-chain powerhouse would be the clearest sign yet that soaring memory costs have become unavoidable - with no end to the memory crunch in sight.
items.line: Rising memory chip costs are forcing all smartphone makers to increase prices, signaling structural supply chain pressures that will persist through 2026-2027.

items.title: Un test de urină poate depista 9 din 10 cazuri de cancer de vezică urinară

items.title: Smart ring maker Oura files to go public, pitching investors on AI-driven preventive health

items.line: Oura's IPO filing signals investor appetite for AI-driven wearable health platforms that enable continuous preventive monitoring at scale.

items.line: Phil Schiller's departure from App Store leadership over concerns about monetization strategy suggests internal Apple conflict on revenue extraction vs. developer ecosystem health.
